articles.title: Script and pronunciation
articles.description: Get familiar with the Mokshan language's basics that will help you study more effectively.

articles.title: About the Mokshan
articles.description: The Mokshan language is one of two major Finno-Ugric languages, common among the peoples of the right bank of the middle Volga.

articles.title: Pre-Christian beliefs of the Moksha
articles.description: Nature deities, spirits of the forest, water, fire and home, and the rise of the supreme god Shkay in Moksha mythology.
